title: 1.108.6 (LTS)
excerpt: Tip The lts image tag always points to the latest LTS release. Pull ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:lts to stay on the newest LTS patch Verify this release cosign verify \ --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/e82a3c646908ba0a6ee0beddc4310d7a6cac4065/cosign.pub \ ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.108.6 Same command for litellm-database , litellm-non_root and the docker.io/litellm/* images What's new in 1.108.6 (LTS) 16 PRs. 7 fixed, 2 changed. 1 needs action Action required Keys, teams and auth: Move tenant_id , client_id , client_secret , azure_username , azure_password and azure_scope request tags into metadata ( #51254 ) Also in 1.106.9 Changes OpenAI: Fixed gpt-5.4 and gpt-5.5 function-tool calls without reasoning_effort being bridged to /v1/responses ( #50968 ) Vertex AI and Gemini: Fixed Gemini image edits being billed at a flat per-image price instead of by tokens ( #51038 ) Chat completions: Fixed 400 on chat and bridged /v1/responses calls that send an allowed_tools tool choice ( #50726 ) MCP: Fixed Slack and GitHub MCP reconnects looping between the provider and the Connect page, broken since v1.107.0 ( #51045 ) Guardrails: Changed Zscaler AI Guard to scan only the latest user message on requests, not the whole conversation ( #50139 ) Cost tracking and pricing: Fixed 500 on usage routes when the database drops during key, user or team detail lookups ( #50253 ) Keys, teams and auth: Fixed key, user and team spend going negative after a scheduled budget reset on mu
